# BFD (`bfd`)

- **Layer**: Application and control
- **Header**: variable length
- **Notes**: [LDP / RSVP-TE / BFD (P2)](../../protocols/mpls-bfd.md)

| Lower layer | Selector | Value |
|---|---|---|
| [`udp`](udp.md) | `dst_port` / `src_port` | 3784 (0x0ec8) |
| [`udp`](udp.md) | `dst_port` / `src_port` | 4784 (0x12b0) |
| [`udp`](udp.md) | `dst_port` / `src_port` | 6784 (0x1a80) |

## Fields

| Field | Type | Default | Auto | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `version` | `uint(3)` | `1` |   | BFD version (1). |
| `diag` | `enum(5)` | `0` (no_diagnostic) |   | Diagnostic code: the reason of the last state change of the local session. |
| `state` | `enum(2)` | `1` (down) |   | Session state: 0 AdminDown, 1 Down, 2 Init, 3 Up. |
| `p` | `uint(1)` | `0` |   | P bit: Poll (a parameter change, the peer answers with F). |
| `f` | `uint(1)` | `0` |   | F bit: Final (answer to a Poll). |
| `c` | `uint(1)` | `0` |   | C bit: Control Plane Independent. |
| `a` | `uint(1)` |   | Number of items of `authentication` | A bit: authentication present (Auto: set when there is an authentication section). |
| `d` | `uint(1)` | `0` |   | D bit: Demand mode. |
| `m` | `uint(1)` | `0` |   | M bit: Multipoint (0). |
| `detect_mult` | `uint(8)` | `3` |   | Detect time multiplier. |
| `length` | `uint(8)` |   | Length of the header in octets | Length of the control packet in octets, including the authentication section (Auto). |
| `my_discriminator` | `uint(32)` | `1` |   | My discriminator: a non-zero value unique to the session on the sender. |
| `your_discriminator` | `uint(32)` | `0` |   | Your discriminator: the peer's discriminator (0 while unknown). |
| `desired_min_tx_interval` | `uint(32)` | `1000000` |   | Desired minimum TX interval in microseconds. |
| `required_min_rx_interval` | `uint(32)` | `1000000` |   | Required minimum RX interval in microseconds. |
| `required_min_echo_rx_interval` | `uint(32)` | `0` |   | Required minimum echo RX interval in microseconds (0 = no echo). |
| `authentication` | `tlv` — `length - 24` octets |   |   | Authentication section (8-bit type, 8-bit length including the header): simple password, keyed MD5 / SHA1 and their meticulous variants. The digest / hash is Manual. |

### `diag`

| Value | Name |
|---|---|
| 0 | `no_diagnostic` |
| 1 | `control_detection_time_expired` |
| 2 | `echo_function_failed` |
| 3 | `neighbor_signaled_session_down` |
| 4 | `forwarding_plane_reset` |
| 5 | `path_down` |
| 6 | `concatenated_path_down` |
| 7 | `administratively_down` |
| 8 | `reverse_concatenated_path_down` |
| 9 | `mis_connectivity_defect` |

### `state`

| Value | Name |
|---|---|
| 0 | `admin_down` |
| 1 | `down` |
| 2 | `init` |
| 3 | `up` |

### `authentication`

- Type 8 bits, length 8 bits.
- The length counts the type and length fields too.
- Unknown types are kept as raw value octets.

| Type | Name | Value fields | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 (0x01) | `simple_password` | `key_id`, `password` |   |
| 2 (0x02) | `keyed_md5` | `key_id`, `reserved`, `sequence_number`, `digest` |   |
| 3 (0x03) | `meticulous_keyed_md5` | `key_id`, `reserved`, `sequence_number`, `digest` |   |
| 4 (0x04) | `keyed_sha1` | `key_id`, `reserved`, `sequence_number`, `hash` |   |
| 5 (0x05) | `meticulous_keyed_sha1` | `key_id`, `reserved`, `sequence_number`, `hash` |   |

## Constraints

| Level | Rule |
|---|---|
| warning | `version` = 1 |
| warning | `detect_mult` ≠ 0 |
| warning | `my_discriminator` ≠ 0 |
| error | header at least 24 octets |
